question: Choose the antonym of 'lucid':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Vague)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lucid"** means something that is clear, easily understood, or expressed in an easy and logical manner. (स्पष्ट, सुस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher gave a lucid explanation of the complex topic, making it easy for all the students to understand.
 
 
 
• **"Vague"** refers to something that is unclear, not well-explained, or lacking definite meaning. It is the direct opposite of "lucid." (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **The directions he gave were so vague that I got lost on my way to the event.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'lucid' **is **'vague'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Vague)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Transparent **(पारदर्शी): Something that allows light to pass through so objects behind it can be distinctly seen. It can also mean being open and honest.

 
 
• **Example: **The glass window was so transparent that I could see the garden clearly.
 
 
 
• **Clear **(स्पष्ट): Free from doubt or confusion; easy to understand.
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were clear, so I knew exactly what to do next.
 
 
 
• **Coherent **(सुसंगत): Logical and consistent; well-structured and easy to follow.
 
 
• **Example: **The speaker presented a coherent argument that convinced the audience.
